answer_1.outputs: The algorithms generate isiZulu number words (cardinal, ordinal, set-of-items, adverbial) in agreement with noun classes, and are used to create a large corpus of grammatically correct sentences.

answer_4.quote: We chose to rely on two isiZulu grammarians to collaboratively evaluate the texts instead of only using isiZulu speakers.
answer_4.guideline: The grammarians evaluated whether each generated text was valid or invalid, or if they were uncertain, and provided optional comments to describe the source of error.
